invariants.rationale: Null operationType would have caused a NullPointerException in the equals call.
The method throws and does not reach exit if operationType is LOG_COMPACT.
table is dereferenced for getInstantGenerator, so it must be non-null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used for containsInstant and must be non-null.
instantTime is passed into getCompactionInflightInstant, so it must be non-null.
